desc: Black galvanized strap hinge fastened to a sturdy wood gate post with bright exterior-rated fasteners, a diagonal wood brace behind it, and dry sandy Florida soil at the post base.
reuse_notes: Use for fence-gate hinges, hinge posts, exterior fasteners, diagonal bracing, gate support, and outdoor repair-scope articles. It depicts a generic gate-hardware detail, never a JK Prestige project or proof that a particular fastener layout is appropriate for every gate.
